en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large ornate classical building complex with a monumental fountain and formal gardens in the foreground. The structure has two symmetrical wings joined by a central colonnade and arch with sculptural groups and water cascading down into a large basin. Pathways, trees, and small figures of people and carriages can be seen in the surrounding park. Printed caption text appears at the top center of the image.
